description: This file declares the implementation of an IPC channel class (`ChannelImpl`) and a factory class (`ChannelFactory`) for inter-process communication within the Rialto project. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and external dependencies related to protobuf messaging, socket communication, and event handling.
external_methods: firebolt::rialto::ipc::ChannelImpl::CallMethod(const google::protobuf::MethodDescriptor *, google::protobuf::RpcController *, const google::protobuf::Message *, google::protobuf::Message *, google::protobuf::Closure *)

classes.name: ChannelFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IPC channels, providing methods to instantiate channels using socket file descriptors or socket paths.

classes.name: ChannelImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the IChannel interface, managing socket communication, message processing, and event handling for IPC.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Creates a new IPC channel using a socket file descriptor or socket path.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the IPC channel is currently connected.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the socket file descriptor associated with the channel.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for socket events with a specified timeout.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes incoming socket events and messages.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a specific event tag.

methods.name: CallMethod
methods.description: Invokes a remote method via protobuf messaging.

methods.name: subscribeImpl
methods.description: Subscribes to a named event with a specified descriptor and handler.
